--- ## Walkthrough The operator adds an Operator API-backed encryption status provider, wires it into KMS health handling, updates the library-go revision, and passes an additional argument to KMS sidecar injection. ### Changes **KMS encryption status integration** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Operator API encryption status provider**
`pkg/operator/encryptionstatusprovider/provider.go`|Creates a provider from REST configuration, reads encryption status from the `cluster` KubeAPIServer resource, and applies updates with server-side apply.| |**KMS health command wiring**
`cmd/cluster-kube-apiserver-operator/main.go`, `go.mod`|Replaces the previous writer and preflight wiring with the encryption status provider and updates the library-go revision.| |**KMS sidecar invocation**
`pkg/operator/targetconfigcontroller/targetconfigcontroller.go`|Adds an empty argument to the KMS plugin sidecar injection call.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant KMSHealthCommand participant EncryptionStatusProvider participant OperatorAPI KMSHealthCommand->>EncryptionStatusProvider: construct provider from rest.Config EncryptionStatusProvider->>OperatorAPI: get cluster KubeAPIServer encryption status OperatorAPI-->>EncryptionStatusProvider: return KMSEncryptionStatus KMSHealthCommand->>EncryptionStatusProvider: apply updated status EncryptionStatusProvider->>OperatorAPI: server-side apply KMSEncryptionStatus ``` **Suggested reviewers:** `ricardomaraschini`, `ingvagund`
